guide.summary: A virus that infects only Velvet colonies sitting in thick slime.
guide.biology: Real viruses that infect bacteria, called phages, each attack only certain kinds of bacteria. Lacephage is a made-up one.
guide.rules: Works like Pinphage, but infects only Velvet, and only in cells where film is at least 0.10. Its viral units hold 0.01 carbon each and spread at half Pinphage's speed. Each tick a Velvet is infected with chance 1 − exp(−0.05 × units in its cell × 0.1), using up one whole unit. An infected Velvet still feeds but cannot divide or heal; after 20 seconds it bursts, turning up to 40% of its body into new units and the rest, with all its minerals, into detritus. Loose units decay by 1% per second into detritus. It never shares units with Pinphage.
guide.example: Grow Velvet on two stones, add Recyclers beside only one of them to eat the film, then add Lacephage and compare the two colonies.
